description: Create a new task from todo.txt content. The content must be a valid todo.txt formatted string. Examples: '(A) Call dentist @phone +personal due:2025-12-31', 'Buy groceries @errands +home', 'Weekly report +work rec:+1w'. The server will parse and normalize the content (shorthand like d:→due:, date format conversion, etc.).
name: create_task
